title: AWSGoat: module 1
description: A damn vulnerable AWS infrastructure by INE, deployed into your own AWS account: a serverless blog (API Gateway, Lambda, DynamoDB, S3) and an EC2 instance, with XSS, SQL injection, IDOR, SSRF on the Lambda environment, sensitive data exposure, S3 misconfigurations and IAM privilege escalation.
question: Starting from the blog as an outsider, escalate to administrator access in the AWS account.
